resources.scope: whole card including unrelated workloads; sampled means, not a quota or process attribution

causal_validation.note: read-only expert observations and stored native acknowledgments; not a new rollout or performance test

limitations: teacher-forced expert state/history and one cached policy-noise sequence per demonstration
force-masked control retains true tactile gate; not a strict tactile-free ablation
aggregate normal-force contacts have unknown partners
diagnostics are two paired starts per mode; local roll-in is not autonomous success
no critic, replay buffer, reward training, or RL implementation
matched physical resets do not guarantee pixel-identical observations or bitwise policy replay; action differences alone are not residual effects

statistics.selection: ceil(train16 contact |expert-base| p99 * 10)/10, bounded .1..2; then frozen
statistics.units: native clipped pre-delay commands, not radians or Cartesian meters

early_stage_waits.source: Actual final JSON stdout rows returned by completed cache workers; copied before tool session history expires
early_stage_waits.includes: Measured admission checks/waits plus REQUESTED deliberate sleep durations; OS sleep overshoot was not separately measured in these early workers. Does not alter simulation time
early_stage_waits.limitation: The first 13-step read-only probe did not persist its separate pacing accumulator. Continuous whole-card telemetry covers that interval; it is not filled with zero. Later workers persist separate admission/pacing totals.

session.rollin_condition: first observation with valid max finger force >0.1 N for 3 consecutive control ticks
session.missing_contact: no switch; report unavailable, no replacement
session.memory: causal warmup from reset, no clearing at switch
session.gate: real current observed max finger force >0.1 N and valid

training_configuration.architecture: independent copied frozen B0 frame encoder; train visual/tactile/intent/motion GRUs and raw residual MLP
training_configuration.loss: 0.5 arm mean squared command error + 0.5 hand; only real contact; delta L2 1e-4
training_configuration.force_control: same real gate/mask; zero both forces before derivatives/contact features; FK/time retained
training_configuration.order: fixed original checkpoint split order, matched B/C
training_configuration.training_history: expert t-1 clipped command, expert actuator targets/tracking; teacher forcing
training_configuration.deployment_history: actual acknowledged student or declared expert-rollin command

disk_scope: 12 GB reserve checked before work; final free space is not a recorded continuous minimum
